### New in 1.5.6
- **Interactive Sticky Notes with Size Selection**:
  - Replicated paper physics from `notes.html`: 3D perspective paper flutter animation, top adhesive tape with pushpin, multi-layered realistic drop shadows, velocity drag tilt, handwriting typography, and split-tear paper rip animation with paper tear sound.
  - Choose note size: Small (`S`), Medium (`M`), Large (`L`) when creating or editing sticky notes on shelves and to-do screens.
  - 6 pastel sticky paper colors (Yellow, Pink, Mint, Blue, Orange, Lilac) and 4 pen ink colors (Blue pen, Black pen, Red pen, Green pen).
  - Add sticky notes directly to shelves in the Library section, and see them displayed in real time on the Home shelves as well.
  - Sticky notes on the To-do page: add reminders, thoughts, and quotes in a dedicated horizontal sticky gallery.
  - Complete persistence: all notes on shelves and to-do pages (including chosen sizes, coordinates, colors, and text) are saved and automatically restored when the app is reopened.
- **Real Open World Bluetooth & Wireless Book Sharing**:
  - Home Shelf Pull-to-Share: press & hold any book on your Home shelf and pull it up to open the share sheet, matching `prototype-share.html`.
  - Complete packaging: selected books are packaged into `.shelfbook` archives containing book metadata, reading progress, marks, custom cover image, and attached PDF/EPUB copy file.
  - Real peer-to-peer sharing: tilted cover preview, live Bluetooth status check, nearby peer scanning with animated radar, 5-letter room code join/copy, and incoming transfer accept toggle.
  - Native Bluetooth & Quick Share: scan for nearest Bluetooth devices and beam the selected book directly to another device.
  - Receiver In-App Acceptance: prompt to review and accept incoming `.shelfbook` files before importing into the "Shared books" shelf with top floating banner (`[View]` and `[Undo]`).
  - Live In-App Wireless Receiver: background local network server (port 8942) allowing direct peer-to-peer beams with real-time in-app confirmation dialogs.
  - No dummy or placeholder data: 100% real book transfer pipeline.
- **Settings Reorganization ("Custom" Button)**:
  - Consolidated Appearance, Shelf style, Pets, and Feel settings under a dedicated "Custom" button with instant sub-navigation.
  - Added "Buy me a coffee" button in Settings to support reading sanctuary updates.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
